body_markdown:
The holiday season is here, and thoughtful gifts can go a long way in supporting a new mom. From technology to relaxation essentials, this guide features gifts that are practical and meaningful—everything a new mom could ask for. Here’s what new moms actually want this holiday season:


### [1. Owlet Dream Sock Smart Baby Monitor](https://owletcare.com/products/owlet-dream-sock)


*Give her peace of mind while Baby sleeps.*


Dream Sock® is an FDA-cleared baby monitor that tracks pulse rate, oxygen, and sleep patterns, offering new moms real-time insights into their baby’s well-being. Paired with the Owlet Dream App, parents can check live health readings and receive notifications whenever baby’s readings fall outside preset ranges. This smart baby monitor brings invaluable peace of mind for moms with babies 1-18 months old.


### [2. Wildbird Aerial Carrier](https://wildbird.co/products/willow-aerial-buckle-carrier)


*Keep Baby close while staying hands-free.*


The Wildbird Aerial Carrier combines style and comfort, making it easy for new moms to keep their little ones close while freeing up their hands. Made from breathable, sustainable materials, this ergonomic carrier provides excellent support for both Mom and Baby. With 2 different size options and chic fabric designs, it’s a functional and beautiful choice for bonding on the go.


### [3. Made By Mary Mama Disc Necklace](https://www.madebymary.com/collections/mama-collection/products/mama-disc-necklace-1)


*A sentimental keepsake she’ll cherish.*


The Mama Disc Necklace from Made By Mary is a simple yet elegant piece of jewelry that celebrates her new role. Engraved with the word "Mama" or personalized with initials, it’s a beautiful way for her to carry a reminder of her little one close to her heart. This timeless piece adds a sentimental touch to her daily outfit, making it the perfect gift to show your love and support.


### [4. Hatch Baby](https://www.hatch.co/baby)


*Help her create the perfect sleep environment.*


The Hatch Baby is a sound machine and night light all in one. With customizable colors and sounds, it helps soothe babies to sleep and gently wakes them. Plus, it’s controllable via a smartphone app, making it super convenient. This little device will be a game-changer for new moms trying to establish sleep routines for their babies.


### [5. Lake Pajamas Pima Robe](https://lakepajamas.com/products/porcelain-robe?variant=40728267751514)


*Comfort and luxury for everyday moments.*


Lake Pajamas’ Pima Robe is made of the softest pima cotton fabric, perfect for cozy mornings and late-night baby feedings. With a comfortable fit and high-quality construction, this robe will help Mom feel pampered during those postpartum days. It’s an essential that brings a touch of luxury to her day-to-day routine, whether she’s relaxing or managing nighttime wake-ups.


### [6. Ember Mug 2](https://ember.com/products/ember-mug-2?variant=32734187126869)


*Hot coffee that lasts as long as she needs.*


With the Ember Mug 2, her coffee (or tea) will stay at the perfect temperature for hours. This smart mug keeps beverages warm from the first sip to the last—no more reheating! For busy new moms who rarely get to enjoy a hot drink, this thoughtful gift will become an essential she didn’t know she was missing.


### [7. Chatbooks Photo Book Subscription](https://chatbooks.com/products/gift-a-subscription?)


*Capture every moment effortlessly.*


The Chatbooks Photo Book Subscription makes it easy for moms to create meaningful photo albums of their baby’s milestones. With simple customization options, it turns digital memories into physical keepsakes. Each month, she’ll receive a new book filled with her favorite snapshots, so she can treasure every precious moment.


### [8. Hydrojug Traveler Water Bottle](https://www.thehydrojug.com/products/cream-traveler)


*Stay hydrated and energized.*


Staying hydrated is crucial, especially for nursing moms. The Hydrojug Traveler 40oz Water Bottle is designed for those who need to stay on top of their water intake and stay refreshed all day. With a large capacity and convenient handle, it’s easy to carry around the house or on errands, helping Mom stay energized and hydrated on even the busiest days.


### [9. Omnilux Contour Face](https://omniluxled.com/products/omnilux-contour-face)


*At-home relaxation and self-care.*


The Omnilux Contour Face red and near-infrared light therapy device brings a spa-like experience into her home. Red light therapy is known for its skin-soothing benefits, and this mask helps rejuvenate the skin while she relaxes. For moms who could use some self-care, it’s a luxurious way to support her well-being and give her a confidence boost.


### [10. DoorDash Meal Delivery Gift Card](https://www.doordash.com/gift-cards/)


*Effortless meals, delivered right to her door.*


A meal delivery gift card, such as DoorDash, is the perfect way to take meal planning off her plate—literally. With endless options to choose from, she can order whatever she’s craving, from quick breakfasts to nourishing dinners, delivered straight to her door. This gift saves time, energy, and offers her the flexibility to pick meals that fit her needs, whenever she needs them. For a new mom juggling feedings and baby naps, the convenience of meal delivery is priceless.


These gifts bring comfort and care to a new mom’s life. Whether it’s a little extra peace of mind with Owlet Dream Sock, or a moment of self-care with a new robe, each item shows you’re there for her in this special season of motherhood.
